packet.title: XSLT backwards-compatible behaviour and XPath 1.0 compatibility mode (implementation)

item.p: XPath 4.0, 2.2.1 (XPath 1.0 compatibility mode in the static context) and the rules that depend on it: general comparisons, arithmetic, and the coercion rules (first item, fn:number and fn:string conversions);

XSLT 4.0, 3.8 "Backwards Compatible Processing" and the 1.0 rules it names (xsl:value-of and attribute value templates take the first item, xsl:number, sort keys, xsl:call-template and parameter conversions); XTDE0160 is no longer raised.
Unlocks: XT40 backwards_compatibility 124 (backwards 47, xpath-compat 18, xslt-compat 13, and others) and QT4 xpath-1.0-compatibility 5. It also unlocks every real-world version="1.0" stylesheet.
Replaces: asks_xslt_1_behaviour and its XTDE0160 raise in src/xslt_lower.c ('s place), and supports-backwards-compatibility.

Mechanism: a flag of the static context that the XPath lowering reads. It inserts the 1.0 conversions as ordinary IR (the first item, then fn:number or fn:string), so the evaluator does not change. XSLT sets the flag for elements whose effective version is below 2.0.
Header: xpath.h, additive: a last field of sxml_static_context_configuration (for hosts and the QT4 driver), with a record. xslt.h: none.

Owns: src/xpath_lower.c (the conversions), src/xslt_lower.c (the XTDE0160 place), src/xslt_lower_construct.c (value-of and attribute value templates), src/xslt_lower_number.c, and new tests/xslt_compatibility_test.c.
Size: 5–10 KB in sxml.wasm, so it waits for 7.2 or for a budget raise; the XSLT part is in the CLI only.
Gate: ≥ 80 % of the 124 and all 5 QT4 cases.

body.p: Done 2026-10-19 (), gate met for XT40, not for QT4: XT40 111 of the 124 (89.5 %); QT4 1 of 5, the four others and ten XT40 cases expect fn:number conversion for xs:numeric parameters (fn:format-number, fn:round, fn:floor), which XPath 4.0, 3.4.1 gives only to xs:double. xpath_compatibility.c is in the core module (a few KB).

7.4b (, follow-ups to 7.4): exsl:node-set and exsl:object-type (EXSLT common, a new well-known namespace), exsl:document as xsl:result-document, docbook-002's XPST0003, text value templates in 1.0 elements without the mode (3.8.1), xsl:result-document's xhtml default in a 1.0 stylesheet (backwards-019b), the size of xpath_compatibility.c in sxml.wasm; the xs:numeric question put to the owner. Done 2026-10-19: XT40 8,940 to 8,943 (docbook-001, docbook-002 and backwards-019b pass); xpath_compatibility.c is about 7.2 KB, the EXSLT part 1.2 KB of the core module.
